chat_history.content: I'm 23 and I have lower back pain after a heavy workout. It started yesterday and gets worse when I bend forward.
When did the pain start, and what movements make it worse?
It started yesterday after deadlifts and feels about a 6 out of 10.
I have chest tightness and shortness of breath that started this morning.
Is the chest tightness severe, and are you feeling dizzy or faint?
It is getting worse and I feel lightheaded.
I have had a sore throat, mild fever, and dry cough for three days.
